'''Loje Nella''' was a shadowy [[Riorian]] [[Gender|female]] who was a member of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]'s [[Jabba's criminal empire|court]]. In [[4 ABY]], she was present in the [[throne]] room booths of [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] during a performance by the [[Max Rebo Band]], which ended in the [[death]] of the [[Slavery|enslaved]] dancer [[Oola]].

Nella later took part in a trap laid for [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], who freed Jabba's prisoner [[Han Solo]] from [[carbonite]] while she thought the Hutt was [[sleep]]ing. Jabba, who had been warned of Organa's disguise as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]], had hidden behind a curtain with Nella and other favored members of his court. Once Solo was free, the Hutt revealed himself and had Solo and Organa captured while the Riorian laughed alongside other court members.

==Biography==
[[File:LojeNella-MaxReboBand-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|300px|Loje Nella listened to the Max Rebo Band perform.]]
Loje Nella was a [[Riorian]] [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> from the [[planet]] [[Rior]].<ref name="Geektionary French" /> She served as a member of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]'s [[Jabba's criminal empire|court]] and spent [[time]] in his [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="Geektionary" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY]].</ref> Nella sat behind a pillar in between two of the booths of Jabba's [[throne]] room during a performance by the [[Max Rebo Band]]. After the group finished one [[Music|song]], they began to play the song "[[Jedi Rocks]]," but their second performance was interrupted when the [[Slavery|enslaved]] dancer [[Oola]] was dropped into the pit below the throne room after she refused the Jabba's advances.<ref name="ROTJ" />

After Oola was devoured by Jabba's pet [[rancor]], [[Pateesa]], [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], disguised as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]], arrived dramatically in the throne room with the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] as her prisoner. After Organa threatened the court with a [[thermal detonator]], Jabba agreed to pay her an increased [[bounty]] for Chewbacca, who was then taken away. Organa and Chewbacca's real purpose in the palace was rescuing their ally [[Han Solo]], who Jabba kept frozen in [[carbonite]] and displayed on one of the throne room walls. Later that night, Organa snuck back into the throne room while she believed everyone was [[sleep]]ing and freed Solo;<ref name="ROTJ" /> however, Jabba had been warned by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] that Boushh was not who they seemed<ref name="DarkSide">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref> and set a trap.<ref name="ROTJ" />
[[File:HoorayForEvil.png|thumb|right|300px|Loje Nella sat with Jabba's favored courtiers and laughed at the capture of Leia Organa and Han Solo.]]
Hidden behind curtains, the Hutt and his court had lain in wait for the princess<ref name="ROTJ" /> for an [[Standard hour|hour]], with Nella hidden in a cramped alcove alongside Jabba as one of his favorite cronies.<ref name="DarkSide" /> Once Solo was thawed and Organa had unmasked herself, Jabba revealed himself to the pair and as the curtains were drawn back while Nella rocked back and forth with laugher alongside the [[musician]]s [[Maximilian Rebo|Max Rebo]] and [[Droopy McCool]]. Solo and Organa were then taken captive,<ref name="ROTJ" /> after which the court celebrated late into the night. However, the next day<ref name="DarkSide" /> Jabba and many of his allies perished after the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] arrived and helped to free Solo, Organa, and Chewbacca.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Loje Nella was a shadowy individual who laughed heartily at the capture of Organa and Solo.<ref name="Geektionary" /> She had [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s and brown skin.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:LojeNella-Puppet-Maquette.png|thumb|right|400px|The puppet of Loje Nella (left) was based on a maquette (right) that was based on a Joe Johnston sketch.]]
Loje Nella appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="ROTJ" /> where she was a puppet<ref name="Who's Who in Jabba's Palace">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> controlled by puppeteer [[Mike Quinn]] from beneath the set.<ref name="Quinn">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarsinterviews.com/original-trilogy/mike-quinn-nien-nunb|text=Mike Quinn (Nien Nunb)|author=Pellegrom, Dennis|work=[https://starwarsinterviews.com Star Wars Interviews]|quote=I have a vague memory of getting inside that Toadstool thing from under the set, too, at one point.|archivedate=20180124195951|nolive=1}}</ref> Concept artist [[Joe Johnston]] drew a concept sketch of Nella for the film<ref name="The Making of Return of the Jedi">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> and a maquette of the character with lighter skin and orange eyes was also created.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> The palace throne room scenes were filmed between [[January 25]] and [[February 8]], [[1982]] on Stage 8 at [[Elstree Studios]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

The puppet's creators in the [[Industrial Light & Magic]] Monster Shop nicknamed the character "Toadstool Terror,"<ref name="Who's Who in Jabba's Palace" /> and in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the she received the name Loje Nella in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''.<ref name="Geektionary" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on a card for the [[Loje Nella/Legends|character]] in the [[1998]] ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] published by [[Decipher]]<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Loje Nella}}</ref> Despite a statement from [[Holocron continuity database]] manager [[Leland Chee]] saying that Nella was a [[Riorian/Legends|Riorian]],<ref name="Riorian">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=01200#16270670|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-02-06|time=3:45 PM|quote=Similar-looking species, with any possible connection yet to be established. Loje Nella is actually a Riorian, since the Rioirian image shown in the RPG ''Wanted by Cracken'' is Ep VI concept art for the character referred to by production as the Toadstool Terror.}}</ref> the character was ultimately established to be an intelligent [[cliffborer worm]] in the Legends continuity.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|369|Nella, Loje}}</ref> In canon, the character has only been identified as Riorian, with no source yet mentioning cliffborer worms.<ref name="Geektionary" />
